Polymers are long-chain molecules made from small molecules linked together.
Four polymers or types of polymer are listed.
1
carbohydrates
2
nylon
3
proteins
4
Terylene
Which polymers or types of polymer are synthetic?
A
1 and 3
B
1 and 4
C
2 and 3
D
2 and 4
